mapper.select: SELECT m.* FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id WHERE rm.role_id = #{roleId} AND m.deleted = 0 ORDER BY m.parent_id ASC, m.sort ASC
SELECT * FROM sys_menu WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY parent_id ASC, sort ASC

SELECT DISTINCT m.* FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1 AND m.menu_type IN (0, 1) ORDER BY m.parent_id ASC, m.sort ASC
